# BETA Technologies to Participate in Upcoming Investor Conferences


November 24, 2026 8:00am EST


SOUTH BURLINGTON, Vt.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- BETA Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BETA) (“BETA”), an aerospace and defense company, today announced its participation at the following upcoming investor conferences:


- Goldman Sachs Industrials and Materials Conference: On Thursday, December 3, 2026, Herman Cueto, chief financial officer, and Devon Rothman, head of investor relations and FP&A, will participate in a fireside chat at the Goldman Sachs Industrials and Materials Conference at 10:10 a.m. ET in New York City. They will be joined by Kristen Costello, head of government and regulatory affairs, for individual and group meetings with investors.


- Bank of America Defense Technology Forum: On Friday, December 4, 2026, John “Chip” Palombini, head of product, will participate on a panel at the Bank of America Defense Technology Forum at 11:30 a.m. PT in West Hollywood, California.


- Bernstein Industrials and Energy Forum: On Wednesday, December 9, 2026, Devon Rothman will participate in investor meetings at the Bernstein Industrials and Energy Forum in New York City.


Investors interested in scheduling a meeting are encouraged to contact BETA’s Investor Relations team or their respective conference representative for more details.


**About BETA Technologies, Inc.** BETA (NYSE: BETA) is an aerospace and defense company designing, manufacturing and selling high-performance electric aircraft, advanced electric propulsion systems, components and charging systems to top operators worldwide. BETA’s intentional approach to developing the enabling technologies necessary to electrify aviation unlocks lucrative aftermarket revenue opportunity over the life of each aircraft. These highly scalable enabling technologies allow BETA to serve a customer base across cargo and logistics, defense, passenger and medical end markets and unlock cost-effective and safe missions. Visit[www.beta.team](http://www.beta.team/) for more information about BETA and its products.
